comparison.objective: Candidate rejects open cartons from a conveyor; PR-771 clamps two boards edge-to-edge with a ratcheting one-hand bar clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic carton tracking, obstruction-aware grasping, and spill-controlled transport versus clamp placement, repeated trigger pumping, force generation, and board alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires correct routing, content retention, released tray dwell, and no contact with closed cartons; PR-771 requires closed board/jaw gaps, at least 20 N clamp force, flush aligned boards, release, and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: The common notions of force control and stable release are generic; clamp actuation and force-retained alignment do not duplicate carton sorting.
